closing: REPLAY of a scripted Studio AI session, not a live model call. get_finding ran against the live database and the PayOps widgets now show the latest finding. Read the labels in the Evidence Inspector: VERIFIED means the number matches the cited stored tool result; ASSOCIATION_SUPPORTED means the server's falsification test supports the slice as a suspected contributing factor (association, not proven causation); CONTRADICTED means the test rejected it (explained_by / refined_to say why); UNRESOLVED means it cannot be told apart from another slice; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE means too little data; SHARE_MATERIAL / SHARE_IMMATERIAL are share-of-excess information only and never decide a driver. I cannot approve or refund anything: use the proposals panel. With an Anthropic key configured, this panel talks to Claude live instead.
